findings.issue: The step `((-1 : ℤ) : ℚ) • B = -B` is written out identically three times as `norm_num only [Int.cast_neg, Int.cast_one]` followed by `exact neg_one_smul ℚ _` (lines 194-195, 280-281, 305-306). `norm_num only` is also being used purely as a `simp only` driver on cast lemmas, which misstates what the step needs.

summary: Four undocumented `change` tactics and a bare `rfl` closing an algebraMap/Int.cast defeq gap, plus three separate blocks of verbatim-duplicated reasoning that should be single lemmas.
